description: This file contains functions for processing JSON strings within a CMake build configuration. It provides utility functions to parse and convert JSON strings into CMake-compatible strings, handling escape sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON-encoded string into a CMake string by removing quotation marks and unescaping escape sequences.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: References a string variable containing JSON data and converts it into a CMake string by invoking json_string_to_cmake.
